findings.evidence: if ctx.fastmcp.call_tool does not apply FamilyAuthorizationMiddleware, a registered-but-family-hidden name sent through brain_call_tool would execute: the new code forwards every name from _mcp._list_tools() before any visibility check and the diff contains no test covering that dispatch for a hidde
findings.title: Forwarded registered names rely on authorization inside ctx.fastmcp.call_tool

findings.evidence: target = TOOL_NAME_ALIASES.get(name) already implies name in TOOL_NAME_ALIASES, so the 'name in TOOL_NAME_ALIASES and' half of the condition is dead; clarity nit only
findings.title: Redundant alias-membership clause

findings.evidence: if 'project' in name adds the project-focus hint to any unknown name containing 'project' anywhere (e.g. brain_projectile_add), so unrelated unknown names get project guidance; message noise only
findings.title: Project hint triggers on bare substring

findings.evidence: stripping a trailing 's' turns 'status' into 'statu' and 'address' into 'addres', which can skew token-overlap suggestions; affects message quality only, never authorization
findings.title: Naive plural folding distorts some tokens

findings.evidence: _unknown_tool_message hardcodes 'brain_find_tool(query=...)' and the project-hint tool names while the transform accepts configurable search/call tool names, so a renamed gateway would produce guidance pointing at a nonexistent tool; names are currently fixed in this repo
findings.title: Guidance hardcodes gateway names

findings.evidence: TOOL_NAME_ALIASES is built from get_args(KnowledgeType) at import while docs/MCP_TOOLS.md lists brain_get_decision/learning/snippet/runbook/adr/plan individually, so adding a KnowledgeType value changes behaviour without touching the docs list; the dict is also a public mutable module global
findings.title: Alias table derived from KnowledgeType but docs enumerated by hand
